verificationMessage: One short step before you hit the pavement: confirm your email address to activate your StrollBar account and start exploring.
verificationFooter: This link expires soon, so it is worth clicking now. Did not create this account? You can safely ignore this email.
accountFooter: You're receiving this because you have a StrollBar account. Happy strolling, and enjoy the exploring!
createdMessage: Your stroll "{{strollName}}" has been created. Cheers, you have become a bit famous!
createdBody: Add stages, include a few photos, and polish the details before publishing. There is now a new route in the world, and you are its author.
statusMessage: A quick update: your stroll "{{strollName}}" just changed status to {{status}}.
purchaseMessage: Great news: someone just purchased your stroll "{{strollName}}". Cheers, you have become a bit famous!
purchaseBody: A new explorer is about to follow your route. Keep exploring and creating; your work is already taking people somewhere interesting.

statusCopy.published: It's live and ready for the world to explore. Excellent work; your stroll is ready for its audience!
statusCopy.draft: It's back in drafts so you can keep polishing it. The spotlight can wait a little longer.
statusCopy.archived: It's been archived, and anyone in the middle of an adventure has been notified.
statusCopy.suspended: It's been temporarily suspended while we review the reported content.
